newsitem.title: DUBAI: Oman stocks active on bank, investment firm shares.
newsitem.headline: Oman stocks active on bank, investment firm shares.

text.p: Trade on Oman's stock exchange was active in the week to Wednesday, with strong buying interest for bank and investment company shares, a market report said.
The Muscat Securities Market index closed higher at 185.36 points from last week's 184.15.
Bank and investment company shares accounted for 84 percent of total trading value of 10.6 million rials from 8.985 million rials the week before.
Of the 58 companies traded in the week, shares of 15 rose, 27 fell and 16 were unchanged, the report said.
